description: This is a modern living room furniture set. The centerpiece is a sleek, black-framed sofa with plush white and beige cushions, accented by vibrant pink fabric. Complementing the sofa is a low-profile black coffee table with two open laptops, suggesting a contemporary and tech-friendly space. To the side, a small ottoman is covered in a striking pink faux fur. The set is placed on a tiled floor with a dark gray background, and a tall, textured wooden planter adds a natural element. The overall aesthetic is chic and functional, ideal for a stylish urban dwelling or a modern apartment.
